why: The omniscience mutation, and the one thing issue #372 forbids outright: refreshing the remembered point without checking line of sight turns a memory of where the target WAS into a live read of where it IS. Invisible in any fixture where the target stands still, which is why the cases here move it while hidden.
killedBy: last-seen contact memory EXPIRED: the contact is dropped after exactly its span, not before
last-seen contact memory NO CONTACT: a tank that has never seen anything remembers nothing
last-seen contact memory REACQUIRED: fresh sight replaces the remembered point outright and re-arms the span
last-seen contact memory REMEMBERED: the point FREEZES when sight breaks, and does not follow the target
last-seen contact memory the aim it produces points at the REMEMBERED place, not the target
memory through the pipeline survives from one tick to the next, and expires on schedule inside step()
